name: seatsure
description: SeatSure - concurrency-safe campus event registration (integrated micro project: Full Stack + Backend + Advanced Database)

scripts.setup: npm run db:create && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: npm run migrate:reset -w @seatsure/db && npm run seed -w @seatsure/db
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @seatsure/server" "npm run dev -w @seatsure/client"
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.build:production: npm run generate -w @seatsure/db && npm run build -w @seatsure/client
